simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פַּטִּישׁ (H6360) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פַּטִּישׁ (paṭṭîysh) means a hammer First listed occurrence: Isa 41 7.

definitions.full: H6360. pattish מַּטִּישׁ noun masculine Jer 50:23 forge-hammer ; — (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Aramaic loan-word according to Frä 85, and so Arabic (compare Arabic tradition in Lane), see מַּטִּישָׁא ᵑ7 ; but Lag BN 103 compare swine's snout , Syriac flat-nosed ); — ׳פ absolute Isa 41:7 ; Jer 23:29 ; construct 50:23 figurative of Babylonian as destroyer.
definitions.rootNote: intensively from an unused root meaning to pound ;
